latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the alipay-aipay-product-intro skill.

- Provides introduction to Alipay AI Wallet and AI Payment products.
- Implements a workflow using HTTP 402 Payment-Needed response to require payment before accessing detailed resources.
- Guides users to complete payment via the alipay-pay-for-402-service skill.
- Includes error handling for user payment refusal and API response exceptions.
